name: Advanced Filesystem: Video Processor
description: Enterprise video processing: metadata probe, thumbnails, transcodification, HLS/DASH adaptive streaming, watermarking via FFmpeg.
project_description: Advanced Filesystem: Video Processor is a submodule of Advanced FileSystem that processes Drupal managed video files with FFmpeg and FFprobe. Its VideoProcessorService probes metadata (dimensions, fps, codecs, duration, bitrate), extracts thumbnails, and generates HLS adaptive-streaming renditions and thumbnail sprite sheets. On demand it produces a broad set of derivatives — trim, resize, focal-point crop, thumbnail-at-time, watermark overlay, audio extraction, hard/soft subtitle embedding, format conversion, speed change, animated GIF, audio normalization, scene contact sheet, and subtitle-stream extraction. Processing runs automatically on upload through the adfs_video_process queue worker (drained by cron) or on demand from per-file admin tabs, a batch form, an edit UI with a JS player/editor, and a dashboard with disk-usage, cleanup and reprocess actions. Jobs live in adfs_video_jobs and derivatives in adfs_video_derivatives. Generated output defaults to the private:// scheme and is protected by hook_file_download; a 'video_processor' Media source plugin is registered. All routes require the module's restricted administer permission.
